operations.announcements.intro: Announcements to the staff of the stores selected: write them, pin them and see who has read them in the staff app. Choose the stores in the top bar.
operations.announcements.demo: The demo has no staff app, so it has no announcements. Once a store uses the staff app on Zalo, this page writes announcements, pins the important ones and shows how many people have read them.
operations.announcements.compose.title: New announcement
operations.announcements.compose.note: The text is plain: a link shows as text and cannot be opened. The message saying a new announcement waits holds neither its title nor its text.
operations.announcements.compose.every: Every store, including stores opened later
operations.announcements.compose.limited: You can send to the stores you manage.
operations.announcements.compose.audienc: It goes to the managers and staff of these stores, except you.
operations.announcements.compose.pinHint: Leave empty to not pin it. A pinned announcement stays first in the list and on the staff app's home until the end of this day.
operations.announcements.compose.publish: Published; nobody is on the recipient list of these stores yet.
operations.announcements.compose.fix: Fix the fields marked in red before publishing.
operations.announcements.compose.forbidd: You cannot publish to these stores: only an owner or a manager of every store chosen can.
operations.announcements.issue.title.too: A title has up to {max} characters.
operations.announcements.issue.title.con: A title is one line of text.
operations.announcements.issue.body.tooL: The text has up to {max} characters.
operations.announcements.issue.body.cont: The text holds only letters, line breaks and tabs.
operations.announcements.issue.stores.to: Choose up to {max} stores, or send to every store.
operations.announcements.issue.pin.after: A pin cannot end after the announcement expires.
operations.announcements.list.title: Published announcements
operations.announcements.list.none: No announcements for the stores selected yet.
operations.announcements.list.scopeNote: The read rate and the recipient list count only the managers and staff of the stores you manage.
operations.announcements.rate.label: Read
operations.announcements.rate.none: Nobody is on the recipient list.
operations.announcements.rate.failed: The read rate could not be loaded.
operations.announcements.readers.show: See who has not read it
operations.announcements.readers.showLab: See who has not read it: {title}
operations.announcements.readers.failed: The recipient list could not be loaded.
operations.announcements.pin.forbidden: You cannot pin or unpin this announcement: only an owner or a manager of every store it names can.
operations.announcements.pin.notManaged: This announcement also goes to stores you do not manage, so you cannot pin or unpin it.
